title: A Wife for Isaac

questions.question: Who did Abraham's servant find for Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:15: Rebekah came out to the well.

questions.question: Where did the servant go to find a wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:4: Abraham sent his servant to his country and kindred.

questions.question: What sign did the servant ask for?
options: A woman who would water his camels
questions.correctAnswer: A woman who would water his camels
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:14: The servant prayed for God to show him the right woman through this sign.

questions.question: Did Rebekah agree to go with the servant?
Who was Rebekah's brother?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:29: Rebekah had a brother named Laban.

questions.question: How many camels did the servant take?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:10: The servant took ten camels.

questions.question: What did the servant give Rebekah after she watered the camels?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:22: He gave her a gold ring and two gold bracelets.

questions.question: Where did Isaac first see Rebekah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:63: Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening.

questions.question: Who was Rebekah's father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:15: Rebekah was born to Bethuel.

questions.question: What did Rebekah do when she saw Isaac?
options: Got down from the camel and covered herself
questions.correctAnswer: Got down from the camel and covered herself
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:64-65: Rebekah dismounted and covered herself with her veil.

questions.question: What oath did Abraham make his servant swear?
options: Not to take a wife for Isaac from the Canaanites
questions.correctAnswer: Not to take a wife for Isaac from the Canaanites
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:3: Abraham made him swear not to take a Canaanite wife for Isaac.

questions.question: Where did the servant make his camels kneel?
options: By the well outside the city
questions.correctAnswer: By the well outside the city
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:11: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well.

questions.question: What did Rebekah's family initially want before she left?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:55: Her family said "Let the young woman remain with us... at least ten days."

questions.question: What comforted Isaac after his mother's death?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:67: Isaac was comforted after his mother's death when he married Rebekah.

questions.question: How were Bethuel and Laban described in relation to Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:15: Bethuel was the son of Milcah, wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother.

key_verse_text: "Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his steadfast love and his faithfulness toward my master."
